menu_options.account: Sign in to my AQI.in account

location.title: Choose a location
location.description: Pick the point to search around. This is prefilled with your Home Assistant location — change it to add a station somewhere else.

account.title: Sign in to AQI.in
account.description: Your own monitors report more than public stations do, including PM1 and particle counts. Every monitor on the account is added.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: AQI.in rejected the saved credentials for {email}.

station.title: Choose a station
station.description: The nearest monitoring stations, closest first.

local.title: Connect to a local Prana Air monitor
local.description: Enter the monitor’s IPv4 address. Reads PM1, PM2.5, PM10, temperature and humidity every 30 seconds without an account. Local PM10 can differ from the cloud reading; local sensors are named separately. Tested on a community monitor with a /data page.

reconfigure.title: Change the local monitor address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new IPv4 address of the same monitor. Its device ID must match.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials, or no AQI.in access token could be obtained
error.no_stations_found: No monitoring stations were found near those coordinates
error.invalid_host: Enter an IPv4 address, without http:// or a path
error.invalid_local_data: The device did not return a recognised Prana Air ID and measurement page

abort.already_configured: This station, account or local monitor is already configured
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This address belongs to a different monitor
abort.reconfigure_not_supported: Only local monitor addresses can be reconfigured
